reviews.title: Better Than 4 Stars, but not Quite 5
reviews.review_text: Okay let's start with how my Mini Fridge arrived. Like all Refrigerators they arrive in an almost open ended box. The fridge sits on a base, then it's covered with a bottomless box & strapped in tightly. Because of this setup my Retro Fridge arrived damaged in 2 different places, it was missing this little plastic piece on the bottom that helps balance the fridge & the cord was forced into the opening on the back, which was extremely difficult to get out without damaging the mechanisms of the fridge. Aside from that, this is a really nice product & we love its functionality. The size is great, both the sections are very spacious for this little guy. It has great features just like a full size fridge. Multiple types of holders on the door, including several for drinks, butter, etc. The main area has 3 shelves inside & a veggie draw. The freezer is spacious as well with 2 separate shelves & ice cube tray. Now when setting up your fridge please be patient & follow directions carefully. You want to take your time allowing the fridge to come to temperature before loading it with food. Pay close attention to the temperature after you begin adding food, so that you can get the temperature right for what you're adding. That being said don't load the fridge with food to quickly, add small amounts at a time so that you don't over work the motor. If you can try to add some items that are already cold or frozen, this will assist your little guy in getting cold easier. After you've found what works for you, be sure to pay attention to both top & bottom sections. Ice will form in the back of the fridge area as well, it's because the freezer is not self defrosting. You'll need to scrape you freezer about every 3 months, but I'd do it a little quicker for better life on your purchase. There's a small hole in the back of the fridge section for water draining, it makes a little noise once in a while but that's completely normal. I'd definitely Recommend this product, with proper care it should last you for years. Thanks

reviews.title: Scratched and suspicious.
reviews.review_text: Received the 4.5 cu in fridge/freezer this morning. Packaging seemed okay but roughed up at the bottom. Once out of the box, I noticed that the freezer door is substantially scratched where it opens, and lessor scratches appear on the side of the refrigerator door. The unit had obviously been scraped by something. The unit seems to work, does cool, been going for about six hours now. However, both sides of the unit are very warm and could be described as hot. I've never known a refrigerator to do that. This concerns me. Doesn't seem to have any dust or dirt on the mechanics, all looks new and there is adequate ventilation. I will probably decide to return the unit because I believe was purchasing a new, undamaged unit, and the heat is an issue.

reviews.title: Not What it Seems
reviews.review_text: 1) The description specifically states this is a refrigerator-like unit, as my Granny Strrle, for whom I ordered this unit, then drove more than 300 miles to deliver/install/set it up, requested. Instead, it has an unadvertised freezer, which Granny Steele does not need. 2) Granny Steele says shelving are static and cannot be adjusted. Thus, a standard gallon of milk can not be stored therein rightside up. 3) Upon discovering the erroneous advertisement listed in 1) above, I called Walmart Customer Care and was advised a $25 promo code would be rendered; to date, it has not . 4) The unit sits unused in my Granny Steele's garage, the purchased extended warranty's being wasted, as is the manufacturer warranty. This has proven to be a horrible experience brought on by faulty advertising and the missing $25 promo code. Granny Steele yet wants a mini fridge sans a freezer and is heavily relying upon me to get one for her. I shall gladly do so once my budget concurs. As it is, I paid for the first unit myself with absolute trust in Walmart. However, once bitten ...
